parameters.name: filter[location]
parameters.description: Only logs at this location, addressed by its KISS `location_id` (ULID).

parameters.name: filter[unit]
parameters.description: Only logs for this unit, addressed by its KISS `unit_id` (ULID).

parameters.name: filter[log_type]
parameters.description: Restrict to one loggable type: `units`, `locks`, or `entrypoints`.

parameters.name: filter[performer]
parameters.description: Full name substring of the person who performed the event.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page to return. Paging details come back in `meta.pagination`.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Rows per page. Defaults to 15, capped at 100.
